releases.notes: MVP cumplido: 8/9 épicas mergeadas en develop. EP-003 pendiente de DoD (wiring_verified=false). Release Gate corriendo 6 gates sobre diff acumulado main..develop.

gate_results.findings: Secrets management isolates API keys (EnvResolver hot-reload, env-only, no hardcoding). Audit.Event omits PII (metadata only: tokens/status/cost/user/agent/tools/cache_hit). DLP sync redaction regex <10ms + timeout guard. KMS envelope encryption mocked (base64, real AES-GCM in Fase 2). Kill-switch aborts TCP on streaming PII. Slowloris protection via ReadHeaderTimeout=5s. No secrets/keys in logs (masked error messages).
